description: Replication package for the paper: code (walk-forward family, 351 Sullivan-Timmermann-White trading rules, bootstrap tests across designs), data preparation scripts with file hashes, Monte Carlo and empirical results, figure and table sources, the LaTeX source and the PDF. One command reproduces every number in the paper.
